info.title: ExhibitOS Studio Draft API
info.description: Optional authenticated private synchronization for independent browser drafts. Artist and curator own their drafts; admin manages drafts in the same tenant. Viewer, foreign owner/tenant and revoked membership are denied. No list/delete/publication endpoint. Mutations atomically persist immutable snapshots and idempotency receipts. Receipt replay rechecks current access and returns the original response; fetch current state before later apply. Strong ETags protect remote revision; local editVersion is independent. Legacy generic PATCH rejects Studio-managed exhibitions. JSON draft metadata is not an OEX archive or backup of artwork bytes. Optional Platform extension candidate.extensions["org.exhibitos.studio/materials"] version1 is validated by both browser and remote POST/PUT after the base public contract. It is not a new OES version; other namespaces are preserved. Presentation extension org.exhibitos.studio/presentation version 1 is validated by browser and API (bounded room cameras, viewpoints and credits); routes remain optional OES navigation. Optional candidate.extensions["org.exhibitos.studio/presentation"] uses exactly {version:1,startCamera?:{roomId,position,target,fov},viewpoints:[{id,name,roomId,position,target,fov}],credits}. Camera vectors have exactly three finite meter numbers bounded to absolute 10000; position lies within the referenced room (X/Z centered half-width/depth, Y 0..height), target differs from position, FOV is 10..120 degrees. Room IDs must exist. At most 64 viewpoints with distinct UUID IDs and 1..512-character names; credits is at most 4096 characters; the serialized extension is at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes. Unknown own versions, extra fields and invalid cameras fail closed on generic draft POST/PUT after full public schema and semantic validation. Other extension namespaces remain preserved. Routes use optional public OES navigation and do not constrain free movement. Artwork org.exhibitos.viewer/lod is a recognized optional Platform namespace: exact version1, one full-primary plus optional coarse declared same-kind asset, bounded triangles1..1000000 or textureSize1..8192, unique IDs, lower coarse detail and actual bytes, max4KiB (contracts/viewer-lod.schema.json). Generic draft POST/PUT and persisted reads enforce these shared semantics fail-closed; unrelated extension namespaces remain preserved.

get.summary: Project approved immutable CMS metadata for authorized Studio editor
get.description: Metadata only. Current session, same-tenant artist ownership or explicit curator assignment/admin access, current metadata approval and current artwork/asset display rights are checked. Viewer is denied. Returns an OES artwork snapshot with relative asset inventory names, never storage keys, original URLs or private authoring notes. previewUrl is an authenticated no-store CMS derivative endpoint; clients must re-fetch metadata and compare revisionId before loading bytes after reopen. Metadata backup does not include assets. Clients append expectedRevision=artwork.revision to previewUrl and check X-ExhibitOS-Artwork-Revision. This binds derivative bytes to the snapshot across a concurrent metadata edit and reapproval.

Draft.description: Full pinned OES draft. Server additionally validates semantic IDs/references, finite geometry/transforms, chronology and accessibility. It does not validate or package artwork bytes. The optional org.exhibitos.studio/materials namespace requires exactly {version:1,surfaces:{surfaceUUID:{color,roughness,metalness}}}, at most64 existing-surface assignments, no case-insensitive UUID aliases and at most16KiB UTF-8 serialized extension bytes. Color is lowercase #rrggbb; roughness/metalness are finite0..1; unknown versions and extra own-namespace fields are rejected as DRAFT_INVALID. No extension means default material. Other extension namespaces are preserved. Optional org.exhibitos.studio/presentation extension is enforced by shared browser/API validation with the exact fields, bounds and room-camera semantics described above; unknown own versions and fields fail closed.

requestId.description: Durable idempotency key scoped to tenant and current user. Preserve exact body and If-Match for retry. Different request intent requires a new UUID.
